authority.rule: Confirmed family identity, physical action, recovered Path implementation names, named race/manufacturer systems and adopted setting facts outrank this derived volume. New equations and generic machinery consequences are DERIVED. Illustrative thresholds, incidents, institutions, dates, inventors and ownership are PROPOSED or UNRESOLVED.

lattice_state.definition: Represent the traversable Q structure as a directed time-indexed graph G_Q(t)=(V_Q,E_Q), where each vertex alpha is a quantized Q address and each edge e(alpha,beta,t) is an admissible protected-state translation during a valid phase epoch.
lattice_state.interpretation: Q-Lattice does not ride a continuous shear and does not shorten a metric. It commits a protected vessel state through one or more indexed discrete Q-address transitions.

epoch_validity.rule: An edge whose epoch closes before commit completion is not partially valid; the solver must reject it or choose a certified fallback.

address_uncertainty.alias_probability: P_alias=P(candidate_address maps to unintended physically admissible state | observations,epoch)
address_uncertainty.guard: Address confidence must never be represented by one unqualified accuracy percentage; alias structure and covariance remain visible.

route_graph.guard: Geometric closeness does not imply graph adjacency; a longer ordinary-space route may be a shorter valid lattice path.

phase_clock.validity: Commit requires |Delta_phi| below the certified family/path envelope for the entire protected volume.

coverage.equation: C_Q=min_{x in protected_volume} c(x); valid iff C_Q>=C_min
coverage.meaning: The whole protected state must be addressable coherently. Local uncovered or weakly covered mass is a state-integrity failure, not merely reduced efficiency.

gravity_interaction.legacy_alignment: Strong gravity distorts reference frames, clock solutions and endpoint/address inference, increasing calculation and power burden. Coefficients remain family-specific and are not copied from metric, gravitic or slipstream systems.

safety_horizon.meaning: Because the lattice is discrete, safety is naturally expressed in valid future address/epoch opportunities as well as physical distance.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Prove repeatable stable discrete Q addresses exist and can be distinguished from continuous Q-boundary behavior.
path_progression.operational_result: No payload translation; establishes discrete address physics.

Maintain protected-state coverage and identity constraints across complex macroscopic payloads.
path_progression.operational_result: Macroscopic local jumps with mandatory coverage and identity checks.

path_progression.operational_result: First autonomous interstellar Q-Lattice translation. Exact recovered implementation name remains controlled by the lineage registry.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Rank multiple candidate lattice paths under alias, epoch, coverage and failure uncertainty while maintaining sectional protected-state observability.
path_progression.operational_result: Operational fleet use with graceful rejection of bad address branches.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Use strategic address atlases, beacon histories and predictive epoch models across sparse or changing lattice connectivity.
path_progression.operational_result: Strategic routing chooses reliable graph connectivity rather than minimum geometric distance.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Continuously co-solve address graph, epoch schedule, protected-state health, vessel frame, destination admissibility and rollback options in a receding-horizon controller.
path_progression.operational_result: Apex systems maintain several authenticated future address chains and discard invalidating branches before commit.

blocks.function: Excite, identify and lock a selected quantized Q address without confusing neighboring or aliased states.
Maintain phase/time reference for valid translation windows; redundancy must be independently comparable.
Provide coherent address coverage for all translated vessel mass and required fields.
Hold certified precommit state descriptors, coverage maps and rollback information through commit.
Authenticate references, construct G_Q, rank candidate paths and reject aliases or closed epochs.
Sequence address lock, phase alignment, coverage proof, commit, exit verification and recovery.
Reject an uncommitted edge or settle post-translation state according to certified family behavior.
Maintain clocks, isolation, heat rejection, health voting and emergency commands independently of primary translation energy.

layout_invariants: Protected-state coverage follows translated volume, not prime-mover footprint.
Clock/reference paths must be independently testable; one common clock is not redundancy.
P4+ systems require sectional cage health visibility and isolation.
Address authentication and destination occupancy checking are safety machinery, not optional navigation software.
Named race/manufacturer machinery authority overrides generic embodiments when present.

power.model: E_commit=E_lock+E_phase+E_coverage+E_translation+E_exit+E_recovery; peak load is dominated by address-lock/commit transients while sensing, clocking and state maintenance persist.
rules: A beacon may reduce address uncertainty or synchronization burden but cannot supply missing protected-state coverage.
A short graph path is not energy-free; difficult addresses can cost more to authenticate, phase-lock or recover from.
Independent reject/recovery reserve is excluded from discretionary route energy.
Near strong gravity, additional reference and field authority can raise total cost even when the lattice edge remains mathematically available.

navigation_control.state_estimation: Fuse local Q spectroscopy, clocks, gravimetry, stellar references, authenticated beacons, address history, vessel-frame state and destination occupancy into candidate address posteriors with covariance.
commit_gates: epoch open through commit plus margin

pre_transit: authenticate address atlas, beacon, clock and destination sources
build candidate graph without inferring adjacency from ordinary distance
certify cage coverage for exact vessel configuration
require independent navigation, machinery and clock votes
commit_sequence: perform final alias and occupancy check
commit only while edge remains valid
verify exit and archive provenance snapshot
emergency: use only certified partial-commit recovery modes
do not retry an unresolved address

routine: sweep resonators for shifted or split address peaks
test recovery reserve under primary-bus loss
compare local gravity/reference solution against route atlas
maintenance.diagnostic_rule: Coherent errors across all sectors implicate shared clock, reference, address model or environment before local hardware; isolated errors implicate local resonator, cage, sensor or carrier path.

signatures.rule: Higher Path may reduce waste and shorten exposed transients but cannot erase family-intrinsic discrete address/phase activity without separate canon.

failures.forensic_rule: Accident reports must separate mathematics, provenance, clocks, coverage, power/recovery, gravity environment, destination occupancy and operator decisions; generic drive overload is insufficient.
